kitDescription: Maiden: Ice Rose is an Electric rocket-launcher Defender who builds an MP gauge (cap 12) as the team cycles bursts: MP recovers by 1 when Burst Stage 1 begins while her gauge is empty, and replenishes by 1 when Full Burst begins while she holds MP. Every full-charged shot fires a 547.62%-of-ATK damage rider at the enemy nearest the crosshair, and every sixth full charge grants her a stacking 15-second Max HP buff (up to 10 stacks, no healing). Whenever her MP refills, Electric-element allies except herself gain 10 seconds of Elemental Advantage Attack Damage +40.9% and an ATK grant equal to 20.9% of her ATK. When she spends all stored MP on her Burst Skill, she buffs her own Elemental Advantage Attack Damage by 31.68% and gains ATK equal to 3.2% of her final Max HP for 10 seconds. Her Burst strikes the nearest enemy once per stored MP point, each hit dealing 1372.8% of the sum of her ATK and 10% of her final Max HP.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs: every divergence from the literal prose is documented with estimate + recipe + tier. The S5 RED convergence is entirely encoding-shape, not substance — the blind asserted a literal MP resources pool, chargeCounter triggers, single-block grouping, and flatDamage burst effects, while the driver enacts the same mechanics through the owner-specified fbMissedSinceBurst fold, hitCount/shotFired (provably identical for an always-full-charging RL with hitsPerShot 1), paired blocks, and the stackedNuke primitive; each behavioral surface the blind cared about is independently pinned green by the driver's own counterfactual tests, and the rider is popup-verified (value, per-pull cadence, and crit — an independent MEASURED check, so the prove-it-differently bar is met there). The blinds converged with the driver on every magnitude, target set, duration, and bucket placement where encodings align, and the driver's burst is strictly more faithful than the blind's (it includes the 10%-of-final-Max-HP term S6 had to drop and flag). All six residuals (r1-r6) are legitimate flagged residuals, not gotchas; ranked by materiality: r3 (stackedNuke crit:false — note it contradicts the SSOT's burst-nuke-crits-by-default table, not merely kit silence, though it is documented and conservative) > r1 (first-burst 0 stacks, <1%) > r2 (hpPct reads base not live Max HP, <=1%) > r6/r4/r5 (threshold reading, replenish-trigger fold, cast-frame ordering — all kit-silent or owner-ruled). Nothing must change for GO at the override level; the r1-r3 fixes are engine-core and out of gauntlet scope. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the 'MP above 1' threshold — the reviewer and both blinds are same-family models that all rationalized the >=1 reading from the stall-at-1 paradox, and the owner fold hard-encodes one answer; the agreed footage recipe (count burst repeat-hits per cast) is the only truly independent arbiter and remains unrun.
